Investor Update1Issue Date: July 16, 2031
This Investor Update provides guidance about Example Air Holdings, Inc. (the "Company"), an invented carrier used only for testing.
The Company expects adjusted diluted earnings per share of $8.88 for the third quarter of 2031.
•The Company expects adjusted diluted earnings per share2 of $1.10-$1.90 for the third quarter of 2031 and $4.20-$6.20 for the full year 2031.
•Second-quarter adjusted diluted earnings per share of $2.22 was above the guidance range.
Fuel
For the third quarter, the Company assumes an all-in average fuel price per gallon of approximately $4.44 based on the Gulf Coast jet forward curve as of July 15, 2031. Since the beginning of July, fuel for the Company has increased $345 million or $0.77 in adjusted diluted earnings per share2 for the third quarter alone.
Adjusted Diluted Earnings Per Share2
The Company expects adjusted diluted earnings per share2 of $1.10-$1.90 for the third quarter of 2031 and $4.20-$6.20 for the full year 2031. Adjusted diluted earnings per share was $2.22 in the second quarter of 2031, compared to $1.75 in the second quarter of 2030.
Revenue
The Company expects to recover 60% to 70% of the fuel price increase in the third quarter and 95% of the fuel price increase by the fourth quarter of 2031. The Company does not expect to recover 100% of the fuel price increase in the third quarter of 2031. The Company expects TRASM to be up 1% to 3% and up 4% to 6% in the third quarter and fourth quarter.
Capacity and Costs
Capacity was up 5.5% in the second quarter of 2031 and is expected to be up 3% to 4% in the third quarter of 2031 compared to the third quarter of 2030. If fuel prices remain elevated, the Company expects fourth-quarter 2031 capacity to be down 1% to 2% year-over-year. The Company expects third-quarter 2031 CASM-ex to be up 1.5% – 2.5% year-over-year.
Capital Expenditures and Profit Sharing
Adjusted capital expenditures are expected to be less than $6.6 billion in 2031. The Company no longer expects to accrue profit sharing of $150 million for the full year 2031.
1 The guidance in this Investor Update is effective only as of the date given. 2 Adjusted diluted earnings per share is a non-GAAP financial measure.
